# 428 El Rio Rd, Danville: text fixture

This folder holds the page text of the 51-page permit set for 428 El Rio Rd, Danville.
It is the acceptance test of the check engine (`test/el-rio.test.ts`). The PDF itself is
not in the repository: it is a client document.

The text is what PDF.js extracts from each page (one line per end-of-line mark). To keep
the fixture short, it holds:

- every passage a finding of the answer key depends on, copied word for word;
- the title blocks, generated by `load.ts` from the two real formats (architectural and
  structural), with each page's sheet number, title and dates;
- `arch-background.txt`: the leftover layers of an older project (4142 Canyon Road,
  Lafayette) that print on every architectural page of the set. `load.ts` appends them
  after each architectural page's own title block, as PDF.js does;
- a short placeholder body for pages that have no finding.

## `pages.txt` format

Each page starts with a header line:

- `=== <page> arch <sheet> <title lines joined by |> ===`: an architectural page;
- `=== <page> struct <sheet> <title lines joined by |> ===`: a structural page;
- `=== <page> raw ===`: the page text as it is (survey, Title 24, CALGreen, Hardy Frame).

The survey (page 4), the CALGreen sheets (27 and 28) and the Hardy Frame sheets (49 to 51)
have no title block with a sheet number. The engine gives them the next free entry of the
cover's sheet index.

## Answer key

The 22 findings of the PRD answer key are listed in `test/el-rio.test.ts`, with the rule
and the sheets each one must name. The engine may report up to 5 other findings.
